explication: Spyder is a desktop scientific Python development environment. Its principal workflow is a user working in the editor, requesting language assistance, and running or debugging code in an interactive console. The architecture also includes project/file browsing, variable inspection, help, and a plugin-based Qt application. The tree and source index establish these product areas, but many plugin implementations were not excerpted; their connections are therefore omitted or marked unverified rather than presented as inspected call paths.
